name: Python ops CLI
description: An operations helper with disabled TLS verification, a shell ping, weak random and SHA-1, an insecure temp file, eval and a hard-coded token. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Many findings from one small file across high, medium and low severities.

fixes.title: Read the token from the environment
fixes.explanation: The token is no longer in the repository.

fixes.title: Verify TLS certificates
fixes.explanation: Certificate verification is back on (the default).

fixes.title: Run ping with an argument list
Use secrets for the session id
fixes.explanation: secrets draws from the OS cryptographic generator.

fixes.title: Use SHA-256 instead of SHA-1
fixes.explanation: SHA-1 is broken for security purposes.

fixes.title: Create the temp file securely
fixes.explanation: mkstemp creates the file atomically with safe permissions.

fixes.title: Parse literals instead of eval
fixes.explanation: ast.literal_eval accepts only literals and cannot run code.
